primitives.name: Home-Away Formation Execution Divergence
primitives.verbatim_quote: Using our automatic formation analysis, we extend this analysis and show that while teams tend to play the same formation at home as they do away, the manner in which they execute the formation is significantly different.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_h': 'Formation type at home (dimensionless)', 'F_a': 'Formation type away (dimensionless)', 'E_h': 'Execution profile at home (vector in field space)', 'E_a': 'Execution profile away (vector in field space)'}
primitives.assumptions: Teams maintain identical formation types but vary execution parameters based on venue context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E_h ≈ E_a, formation is invariant; when |E_h - E_a| > threshold, divergence occurs.

layer2.mapping: Kernel density estimation of positional distributions across home/away contexts enables tactical divergence quantification.
layer2.telemetry: Positional deviation maps and execution entropy metrics

primitives.name: Forward Third Possession Advantage
primitives.verbatim_quote: In a paper we published recently, using an entire season of ball tracking data we showed that home teams had significantly more possession in the forward-third which correlated with more shots and goals while the shooting and passing proficiencies were the same.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{fwd}': 'Proportion of possession in forward third', 'N_{home,fwd}': 'Home possession in forward third (count)', 'N_{away,fwd}': 'Away possession in forward third (count)', 'N_{total}': 'Total possessions (count)'}
primitives.assumptions: Passing and shooting proficiency remain constant between venues.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If \Delta P_{fwd} < 0, no advantage; if \Delta P_{fwd} > 0, home advantage exists.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to expected goal differential under fixed efficiency constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Shot conversion rate and possession duration metrics

primitives.name: Tactical Conservatism Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: This conservative approach at away games suggests that coaches aim to _win their home games and draw their away games._ Additionally, we also show that our method can visually summarize a game which gives an indication of dominance and tactics.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{cons}': 'Tactical conservatism index (dimensionless)', 'd_i^{away}': 'Defensive depth at away game i (meters)', 'd_i^{home}': 'Defensive depth at home game i (meters)', 'n': 'Number of games analyzed (count)'}
primitives.assumptions: Defensive positioning correlates with tactical conservatism.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If T_{cons} > 0, conservative strategy; if T_{cons} < 0, aggressive strategy.

layer2.mapping: Kernel-based regression of defensive positioning against outcome targets.
layer2.telemetry: Defensive line displacement and win/draw probability shifts
